verdict.rationale: Featurebase exposes API endpoints (e.g. GET posts, Reports API) that could be used to pull feedback and analytics data programmatically, which offers a path to data portability, but there is no first-party documentation of a dedicated 'export all your data' feature, bulk/full-account export, or explicit open-format (CSV/JSON) export guarantee for leaving the platform. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data-export tool or documented open-format bulk export, confirmation that all data types (docs, changelogs, roadmap, users) are exportable, and any independent verification of a clean 'leave with your data' workflow.
